channels.name: PCIe Link
channels.purpose: Underlying transport. Carries all SQ fetches (MRd), CQ posts (MWr), data buffer reads/writes (MRd/MWr), doorbell writes (MWr), and interrupts (MSI-X message TLPs). Width = ×1 / ×2 / ×4 / ×8 / ×16 lanes.
channels.active_levels: Per PCI Express Base Spec (Gen 1: 2.5 GT/s; Gen 2: 5.0 GT/s; Gen 3: 8.0 GT/s; Gen 4: 16.0 GT/s)
channels.idle_level: L0s / L1 / L1.x electrical idle per PCIe PM

channels.name: REFCLK
channels.active_levels: Per PCI Express Card Electromechanical Spec (HCSL or SRC-clk)

channels.name: CLKREQ#
channels.purpose: Optional clock request for clock power management (M.2 only)

channels.name: Host SQ memory
channels.purpose: Submission Queue ring buffers in host DRAM (or CMB if supported)

channels.name: Host CQ memory
channels.purpose: Completion Queue ring buffers in host DRAM (or CMB)

channels.name: Host PRP/SGL buffers
channels.direction: bidirectional (host buffer / controller MRd or MWr)
channels.purpose: Data buffers + metadata buffers + PRP Lists + SGL segments in host DRAM

channels.name: MSI-X Table
channels.purpose: MSI-X interrupt vectors targeting host CPU APIC / GIC

supplies: +3.3 V (4-5 W typical, up to 8.25 W for 2280)

ordering_rules.byte_ordering: Little-endian for all on-the-wire fields (PCIe MWr/MRd payloads, CDW0..CDW15, CQE DW0..DW3). All multi-byte fields in NVMe data structures (Identify Controller, Identify Namespace, Log Pages) are little-endian.
ordering_rules.tlp_ordering: PCI Express Producer/Consumer ordering: posted writes (MWr including CQE post) cannot pass other posted writes (Strong Ordering). Read completion TLPs may be reordered relative to posted writes if Relaxed Ordering attribute set.
ordering_rules.phase_tag_polling: Host polls CQE.P bit (DW3 bit 16) to detect new completions; bit inverts on each ring wrap, so initial P=0 means 'no new entry' on first pass; P=1 means 'new entry'; on second pass, P=0 means 'new entry' again; etc.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Host writes SQyTDBL → controller fetches SQE → executes (data via PRP/SGL) → posts CQE → asserts MSI-X → host reads CQE → host writes CQyHDBL.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Data buffer reads/writes precede CQE post (Strong Ordering on PCIe ensures host sees data committed before completion); CQE post precedes MSI-X assertion.

handshake_pairs.name: SQ_DOORBELL
handshake_pairs.rule: Host writes SQyTDBL = new Tail; controller fetches all entries Head..new Tail-1.

handshake_pairs.name: CQ_DOORBELL
handshake_pairs.rule: Host writes CQyHDBL = new Head; controller may reuse slots Head_old..new Head-1.

handshake_pairs.name: CQE_POST
handshake_pairs.rule: Controller writes CQE to CQ ring; Phase Tag inverted on wrap; carries SQHD.

handshake_pairs.name: MSI_X_INTERRUPT
handshake_pairs.rule: Controller asserts MSI-X vector after one or more CQEs posted; vector = Create I/O CQ.IV.

handshake_pairs.name: DATA_TRANSFER
handshake_pairs.rule: Controller issues PCIe MWr (Read) / MRd (Write) TLPs targeting host PRP/SGL buffers.
